Ticket #16 — Content Moderation Workflow

Difficulty: Medium

Practice Metadata

  • Interview format: Engineering ticket / existing-code debugging.
  • Primary skills: code navigation, state invariants, regression testing, implementation judgment.
  • Expected duration: 50–60 minutes.
  • AI assistance: Allowed in guided practice mode for explanations, hypotheses, test ideas, and focused hints; the candidate owns and explains every change.
  • Candidate objective: Trace the reported behavior through the supplied code, state an invariant, make a focused change, and prove it with a regression test.
  • Interviewer evaluation: Problem decomposition, code navigation, root-cause explanation, incremental implementation, and test evidence. See the shared interviewer rubric.

Context

You maintain a discussion site's moderation queue. Submitted posts begin pending. A reviewer can approve a post for publication or reject it. The audit history is a saved record of who made an accepted decision and why; authors may not decide their own posts.

Practice report

Submit post-1 as author-1, then call review("post-1", "author-1", "approve", "self review").

Observation Current starter Expected
Result published forbidden
Stored post status published pending
Audit events for the post 1 0

Acceptance Criteria

  • Only approve and reject are valid decisions. Unknown posts and unsupported decisions return invalid without changing posts or audit history.
  • Authors cannot review their own posts. A forbidden self-review preserves the pending post and adds no audit event.
  • An accepted approval changes a pending post to published; an accepted rejection changes it to rejected.
  • Each accepted decision appends exactly one audit event with post ID, actor, decision, and note.
  • A post already decided cannot be decided again. A later review from another reviewer returns conflict without replacing its status or appending history.

Out of Scope

Use the existing caller-supplied reviewer identity and in-memory store. Account roles, automated content analysis, appeals, and concurrent database updates are outside this ticket.

Investigation

Trace the self-review report and compare the result with an independent reviewer's approval and rejection. Add tests that observe both post state and audit entries after valid, invalid, forbidden, and repeated decisions.
